proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 1851 article gives Malayalam kuṟu short, little, brief; kuṟutu, kuṟiyatu what is short; kuṟu nari, kuṟukkan jackal; kuṟuka to grow short, be abridged, thicken by boiling; kuṟukku what is short; kuṟukkuka to shorten, diminish, boil down, contract, pull in; kuṟuppam shortness; kuṟumpu…. The Byari survey form kore “few” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
